html:
Update21 May 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
📜 Patch Notes - May 21, 2026
Delphinad Ghost Ships return to Exeloch with new regional spawn timers, Kapiros now offers daily rewards, and a new currency arrives. Plus fixes for Lusca gates, braziers, ship cannons, buff persistence, and more.

Features

  • Delphinad Ghost Ships have had their Exeloch spawn reactivated, and their timers changed:
    • Ynystere will now spawn at 14:15 server time (EU Timer)
    • Heedmar will now spawn at 21:15 server time (NA Timer)
    • Exeloch will now spawn at 03:15 server time (OCE Timer)
  • Kapiros seems to have a new type of craving, and they'll pay! You should check in with them once a day.
  • A new form of currency has been added.

Bug Fixes

  • The Abyssal Attack Worldgate will now properly open for Lusca Awakening at the Diamond Shores Nuian Ezi's Light (ty @denlor)
  • Thunderstruck Braziers now last 3 days (matching Warm and Hot Regrade Braziers)
  • The Egg Basket Teleport Scroll can now be used in dungeon peace zones. (ty @r3pl0id)
  • Spellbook: Bulwark can now be used inside of Nui's Protection
  • Torr's Pufferfish Ship has had it's giant cannon adjusted for usability
    • Mounting point is no longer in an awkward spot that gets players stuck in an invisible cage
    • Firing point is now the tip of the cannon (visuals)
  • Torr's Pufferfish Ship's Giant Cannon deals reduced damage to buildings in an active territory siege.
  • The "Ferocity" option on Combat Manuals now properly consume an item when used.
  • All ranks of Health Lift, Hummingbird Ditty, and Aranzeb's Boon will now persist through death properly.
  • The icons for Comet Shard, Goldwraith Kirin and Dragon Slayer have been adjusted/fixed.

== Features ==
* Delphinad Ghost Ships have had their Exeloch spawn reactivated, and their timers changed:
** Ynystere will now spawn at 14:15 server time (EU Timer)
** Heedmar will now spawn at 21:15 server time (NA Timer)
** Exeloch will now spawn at 03:15 server time (OCE Timer)
* Kapiros seems to have a new type of craving, and they'll pay! You should check in with them once a day.
* A new form of currency has been added.

== Bug Fixes ==
* The Abyssal Attack Worldgate will now properly open for Lusca Awakening at the Diamond Shores Nuian Ezi's Light (ty @denlor)
* Thunderstruck Braziers now last 3 days (matching Warm and Hot Regrade Braziers)
* The Egg Basket Teleport Scroll can now be used in dungeon peace zones. (ty @r3pl0id)
* Spellbook: Bulwark can now be used inside of Nui's Protection
* Torr's Pufferfish Ship has had it's giant cannon adjusted for usability
** Mounting point is no longer in an awkward spot that gets players stuck in an invisible cage
** Firing point is now the tip of the cannon (visuals)
* Torr's Pufferfish Ship's Giant Cannon deals reduced damage to buildings in an active territory siege.
* The "Ferocity" option on Combat Manuals now properly consume an item when used.
* All ranks of Health Lift, Hummingbird Ditty, and Aranzeb's Boon will now persist through death properly.
* The icons for Comet Shard, Goldwraith Kirin and Dragon Slayer have been adjusted/fixed.
